title: Playing with Punch Miller
summary: He played jobs with Punch Miller and Al Goodman.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Well we thought, you wanted to ask something. Did you ever play with Punch Miller?

Yeah, Punch Miller. See Punch Miller left here long years ago and he come back here and I played a few jobs with him, and with him and Al Goodman the bass player, he's a little Al, and he's living down there on Full Street, and I played some jobs with him, but I didn't play too many but I played a good bit of them.
You never played out of time with him up on the road or something?

No, I don't know. I believe we went to, what the hell I went, I went to Pencil Court and Milton White and somebody, I know I went there with Andrew Anderson, and I went to Keith McPhee with George Williams, you know there's a naval bass player.
